newsitem.title: UK: Datrontech drops after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Datrontech drops after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in personal computer component distributor Datrontech Group Plc plummeted 24 percent on Wednesday after the company warned that a sharp slowdown in PC sales growth would hit its first-half results.
The stock was down 49-1/2p at 160 by 1216 GMT in thin trade of 5,500 shares.

Chairman Ian Kirkpatrick told the comapny's annual shareholders' meeting that sales of PC component-related products were disappointing, though the company was making strong progress in its networking, storage and IT services activities.

"Given the difficult market conditions," Kirkpatrick said, "we currently expect that the results for the first half are likely to show a pre-tax profit which is below that achieved in the equivalent period last year."

He cited figures from research group Context, showing a 40 percent drop in PC sales growth in the UK and a 30 percent drop in continental Europe, as illustrating the tough market conditions the company faced.
